high_level_description: This image is a meme that humorously contrasts the financial success of a company with the lackluster reward for its core workers. The meme is divided into two sections. The top section shows a person lying on the ground surrounded by an impressive collection of luxury sports cars. The text above reads "COMPANY MAKES RECORD PROFITS," indicating that the company has achieved significant financial success. The setting appears to be a showroom or garage filled with high-end vehicles, suggesting wealth and prosperity.
